title: CI/CD Security Guide — Companion Code
title_es: Guía de Seguridad CI/CD — Código complementario
description: Hardened CI/CD reference files: a security-hardened GitHub Actions workflow with OIDC, SHA-pinned actions, Trivy scanning, cosign signing, and a runner hardening checklist.
